home.metaDescription: Turn logs and stack traces into structured postmortems: timeline, root cause, impact and follow-up tasks.
home.title: From messy logs to a postmortem ready for review
home.subtitle: Paste logs, stack traces or a description of the incident. You get a timeline, root cause, impact and follow-up tasks in a document you can export.
home.emptyInput: Paste logs or describe the incident to generate the postmortem.

steps.cause: Separating symptoms from the root cause

timeline.title: Incident timeline
timeline.desc: Ordered events tagged as alert, detection, escalation, action or resolution.

cause.title: Root cause and cascade
cause.desc: Tells the initial trigger apart from the symptoms it caused in other services.

actions.title: Follow-up tasks
actions.desc: Actions with priority and a suggested owner, plus monitoring recommendations.

export.title: Export
export.desc: Download as PDF or Markdown, or copy the result into your ticketing tool.

home.footer: Built by Luis Merino · Format inspired by the Google SRE Book
